messages:
rachel (security): Asha, auditor requested RBAC change evidence + KMS Decrypt correlation for last 90 days. Need redacted artifacts and incident linkage if present.

Asha (auditor): Correct. Deliver: RBAC change list (who/when/what + ticket), KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey extracts, correlation table (principal -> change -> matched event), retention snapshot. Redact emails.

om (eng-sre): Plan: pull iam_audit table + CloudTrail KMS events. Correlate by assumed-role arn and principalId within 7 days. Will mark confidence (exact/proximate).

devin (platform): Packaging: RBAC_changes_90d.csv, kms_decrypt_90d.jsonl (redacted), correlation_index.csv, correlation_notes.txt, retention_snapshot.txt, evidence_manifest.txt. evidence-bot will stamp manifest.

om (eng-sre): Sample redaction: replace user email with USER-###, truncate s3 keys to prefix like s3://redwood-prod/embeddings/..., keep keyId arn intact.

Asha (auditor): Good. For any matched Decrypts tied to an incident/vuln triage include incident_id + one-line summary only. No playbook details.

rachel (security): We'll include ticket links for RBAC changes and annotate whether the change granted kms:Decrypt or attached a policy. Also flag scheduled maintenance exceptions.

om (eng-sre): Splunk query I'll use: index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey*) | table _time userIdentity.principalId userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters.keyId resources

evidence-bot: upload_started s3://redwood-audit/soc2/pack_1767002468/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv

om (eng-sre): ETA ~90 minutes for filtered export and presigned link. Will include correlation confidence and narrative per match.

evidence-bot: upload_complete s3://redwood-audit/soc2/pack_1767002468/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv (sha256: d41d8cd9...)
__notes: Follows agents.md: single continuous Slack thread string; required metadata fields included; no title field.
